Name: iKeychain's Winter Lychee Plant (JA)
Author: ikeychain
Description:
My first crop mod. This mod adds a singular new crop, the Winter Lychee. A fictional but rare strain of lychee that only grows as a plant, as opposed to the original variant's tendency to only grow as a tree. It also, as the name implies, only strives in the Winter. [b][i]Also only appears after Year 1. [/i][/b]

Follow me on [url=https://x.com/iKeychain]Twitter[/url]﻿ & [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ikeychain.blog]Bsky[/url]! I've been drawing Abigail art for a decade! [u]
[/u]

Downloads.Description: Only appears after Year 1. Requires JsonAssets. Extract [iKeychain] Winter Lychee Plant to your Mods folder.
